name: kite
description: Design in Kite: Codex draws banners, posts, ads, logos and screens into a design file your team edits and comments on.

interface.longDescription: Kite is a design tool built for agents. With this plugin, Codex makes real, editable design files — banners, social posts, ads, logos, landing pages and app screens — on a canvas your team opens, edits and comments on. It follows your design system's tokens, reads comments and applies them, and hands back a link.
defaultPrompt: Design a launch banner and three social posts in Kite, and give me the link
Read the comments on my Kite file and apply them
Make a landing page in Kite using my repo's CSS variables as the design system

positive.prompt: Design a 1080x1080 Instagram post in Kite announcing our summer sale, and give me the link.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new Kite design file with one 1080×1080 frame announcing the summer sale, checks it with a rendered preview, and returns the file's kite.new link.

positive.prompt: What design files do I have in Kite?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's Kite files by name with their links, without changing anything.

positive.description: Find a file and describe it
positive.prompt: Find my Kite file about the product launch and tell me what's on it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the launch file and summarizes its frames (names and sizes) without changing anything.

positive.prompt: In my product launch file, make the headline on the hero banner bigger and change it to the brand's primary colour.
positive.expected_behavior: Edits only the headline layer (size and colour from the file's design-system token), shows a preview, and leaves the rest of the design as it was.

positive.prompt: Read the comments on my product launch file and apply them.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the file's comments, makes the requested changes to the layers they point at, and replies to each comment saying what changed.

negative.expected_behavior: Does not act: Kite's tools cannot delete an account. Explains that the account can be deleted in Kite's settings.

negative.prompt: Buy me a paid Kite plan.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not act: the plugin makes and edits design files and cannot buy plans or take payments. Points the user to kite.new.

negative.prompt: Open the private Kite files of another person that were never shared with me.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not act: Kite only reaches files in the signed-in account or shared with it, and says so.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: Kite's hosted MCP server, with OAuth sign-in, and the Kite design skill — make design files, draw and edit layers with design-system tokens and components, render previews, and read and answer comments.
